_meta.note: Step order mirrors source order exactly — do not sort.

steps.desc: The recent-human-attacks counter is halved (it stretches multiplayer turn timers while fighting is hot).
steps.title: Combat heat decays

steps.desc: Every Occurrence (in shuffled order) rolls its start chance and picks a target tile; the tile owner may get an occurrence-ready Event first.
steps.title: New Occurrences may start

steps.desc: Each yield's price moves one tick per point of built-in demand, then the turn's price is recorded for the history graph.
steps.title: Market prices drift

children.desc: A pillaged improvement counts down one turn; at zero it is destroyed outright.
children.title: Pillage timer ticks

children.desc: An unfinished improvement with no worker on it loses one turn of progress (back up to its original cost).
children.title: Abandoned construction regresses

children.desc: On an active city site, a player whose trade-outpost timer just expired founds a free city there.
children.title: Trade outpost founds a city

children.desc: A camp may launch a raid at a nearby city (raid-prob roll, blockable by the tribe-raid event), or — for non-diplomacy tribes — convert to a neighboring tribe.
children.title: Tribal camps act

children.desc: Improvements that upgrade over time tick their develop counter.
children.title: Improvements develop

children.desc: Improvements that periodically produce units count down.
children.title: Unit-spawning improvements tick

children.desc: When the spawn timer hits zero it resets and the improvement's unit appears.
children.title: Improvement spawns its unit

children.cond: the roll hits (odds improve over time)
children.desc: A harvested resource rolls to come back; odds improve every turn after the first two.
children.title: Harvested resources regrow

children.desc: Regrowing vegetation rolls to advance a stage; city regrowth modifiers apply.
children.title: Vegetation grows

children.desc: Regrowing vegetation rolls to advance a stage; city regrowth modifiers apply.
children.title: Vegetation grows

children.desc: Recent-attack heat on the tile decays (paused while a damaged city or settlement sits on it).
children.title: Tile combat memory fades

steps.desc: Pillage timers, abandoned construction, resource regrowth, vegetation growth and spread, tribal camp raids — the per-tile sequence below.
steps.loop: for each tile on the map
steps.title: Every tile updates

steps.desc: Rural pockets fully surrounded by urban tiles are claimed, and pending city-territory expansion tiles are assigned to their owners.
steps.title: Borders fill in

children.desc: If the tribe's leader has died, a new adult leader character is generated.
children.title: Tribal leader replaced if dead

children.desc: The tribe adopts whichever world religion is most represented among related characters.
children.title: Tribal religion drifts

children.desc: If the tribe has no settlements left (and no player ally), each unit rolls 1-in-10 to become raiders targeting the best nearby city.
children.title: Site-less tribes turn raider

steps.desc: Pillage timers, abandoned construction, resource regrowth, vegetation growth and spread, tribal camp raids — the per-tile sequence below.
steps.title: Every tile updates

steps.desc: Each player's trade agreements whose duration has run out are removed.
steps.title: Trade deals expire

steps.desc: Each player's tribute arrangements whose duration has run out are removed.
steps.title: Tribute deals expire

steps.desc: Every team-vs-team and tribe-vs-team war score loses 5% (×19/20).
steps.title: War scores decay

steps.desc: Each founded religion rolls its spread chance; on success it spreads to one more city.
steps.title: Religions spread

steps.desc: Each religion re-evaluates which character should be its head.
steps.title: Religion heads update

steps.desc: Religions whose prerequisites are now met get founded in the highest-scoring eligible city.
steps.title: New religions may be founded

steps.desc: Every player recomputes what each character thinks of them.
steps.title: Character opinions refresh

steps.desc: Every player recomputes each religion's opinion of them.
steps.title: Religion opinions refresh

steps.desc: Every player recomputes each family's opinion of them.
steps.title: Family opinions refresh

steps.desc: Military power, yield rates, family and religion opinion, victory points and legitimacy are logged for this turn's graphs.
steps.title: Graphs record turn rates

steps.desc: Each city (after the early-game grace period) rolls its rebel probability and may spawn a rebel unit.
steps.title: Cities roll for rebels

children.desc: Each promotable unit on this tile gains the XP its improvement (and adjacent friendly improvements) grant per turn.
children.title: Improvement XP awarded

steps.desc: Units standing on XP-granting improvements (or adjacent to them) gain XP; half-elapsed pillage repairs are logged.
steps.title: Owned tiles grant unit XP

steps.desc: The leader's Years Reigned stat increments (plus Years as Regent for regents).
steps.title: Reign counters tick

steps.desc: The leader's Years Reigned stat increments (plus Years as Regent for regents).
steps.title: Reign counters tick

steps.desc: Any Orders past your maximum are automatically sold for money.
steps.title: Orders above the cap are sold

steps.desc: Any yield stockpile still below zero after debts is set to 0.
steps.title: Negative stockpiles clamp to zero

steps.desc: Projects with a spread chance roll to copy themselves from a city that has them to another of your cities.
steps.title: Spreading projects propagate

steps.desc: Each luxury resource's city and family assignments are re-checked; over-assigned luxuries are pulled back.
steps.title: Luxury assignments verified

steps.desc: Expired memories (timed opinion modifiers from past actions) are removed.
steps.title: Opinion memories fade

steps.desc: If another family has overtaken the dominant one, the family-supremacy event fires.
steps.title: Family supremacy check

children.cond: a unit is capturing the city
children.desc: +1 while a unit is occupying the city; the city flips at its capture threshold (see City Capture Mechanics).
children.title: Capture counter ticks

children.desc: An un-besieged tribal city heals a percentage of max HP.
children.title: Tribal city heals

children.desc: Diplomacy-capable tribes roll to add a random improvement to the city.
children.title: Camp may add an improvement

children.desc: The tribal city rolls to produce a tribal unit nearby.
children.title: Camp may train a unit

steps.cond: skipped on the player's very first turn
steps.desc: Tribal cities you finished capturing last turn now transfer (or raze) — see City Capture Mechanics; the per-city capture sequence below.
steps.title: Captured tribal cities flip

steps.desc: Each city's positive yield output is added to the yields-produced counters that ambitions and quests track.
steps.title: City output tallies toward goals

steps.cond: skipped on the player's very first turn
steps.desc: While a shortfall yield would go negative, the best-suited city is forced onto its culture's shortfall project.
steps.title: Shortfall projects forced

steps.cond: skipped on the player's very first turn
steps.desc: If nothing is being researched, the AI's best tech is slotted temporarily so incoming Science isn't wasted.
steps.title: Empty research slot auto-filled

children.desc: A damaged city heals a percentage of its max HP.
children.title: City heals

children.desc: A city still assimilating ticks down at its culture's assimilation rate.
children.title: Assimilation progresses

children.desc: From the raid start turn, the city rolls difficulty-based odds to spawn a raider party on a distant valid tile aimed at it.
children.title: Distant raid roll

children.desc: A city building nothing is given its culture's default project so production is never wasted.
children.title: Default project fills an empty queue

children.desc: Local yields add to their progress bars; global yields are handed up to the player to bank after all cities run.
children.title: City yields accrue

children.desc: This turn's production (plus stored overflow) goes into the current build.
children.title: Production applies to the build

children.desc: If the current build's cost is now met, it finishes — the unit spawns / building, project or specialist takes effect immediately.
children.title: Build completes

children.cond: owned; skipped on the first turn
children.desc: Partial progress on builds sitting in the queue (not currently first) decays by a percentage.
children.title: Queued progress decays

children.desc: Queued projects, specialists and units that are no longer legal are removed.
children.title: Invalid builds pruned

steps.cond: skipped on the player's very first turn
steps.desc: Units standing on XP-granting improvements (or adjacent to them) gain XP; half-elapsed pillage repairs are logged.
steps.title: Owned tiles grant unit XP

steps.cond: skipped on the player's very first turn
steps.desc: Non-city income plus every city's global yields (Money, Science, Civics, Training, Orders) hit the stockpiles — Science goes straight into the current tech and can complete it here.
steps.title: Global yields bank

steps.desc: Non-city income plus every city's global yields (Money, Science, Civics, Training, Orders) hit the stockpiles — Science goes straight into the current tech and can complete it here.

steps.desc: Non-city income plus every city's global yields (Money, Science, Civics, Training, Orders) hit the stockpiles — Science goes straight into the current tech and can complete it here.
steps.title: Global yields bank

steps.cond: skipped on the player's very first turn
steps.desc: The Science stockpile flushes into the current tech; when progress reaches the cost, the tech is acquired on the spot.
steps.title: Research progresses / tech completes

steps.desc: If research was auto-slotted two steps ago, the choice is cleared again so a human can pick freely.
steps.title: Auto-picked tech un-selected

steps.cond: skipped on the player's very first turn
steps.desc: While money is negative, goods are sold automatically; if still short, money resets to zero.
steps.title: Debts force auto-sales

steps.desc: Any yield stockpile still below zero after debts is set to 0.
steps.title: Negative stockpiles clamp to zero

steps.desc: Units standing where they can no longer be (e.g. lost territory) are pushed to a valid tile — or killed if there is none.
steps.title: Stranded units bounce

children.desc: A unit told to pass last turn becomes active again.
children.title: Pass order clears

children.desc: A sleeping (non-hidden) unit wakes if a hostile unit is adjacent.
children.title: Sleepers wake near hostiles

children.cond: a hostile unit is in range
children.desc: A unit on sentry wakes if a hostile unit enters sentry range.
children.title: Sentry breaks on contact

children.desc: March status resets at turn start.
children.title: March order clears

children.desc: Temporary unit effects count down and expire (possibly chaining into a follow-up effect).
children.title: Timed unit effects tick

children.cond: effect not already on the unit
children.desc: City-territory effects roll their chance to put a timed effect on the unit standing there.
children.title: Territory effects may apply

children.desc: A unit improving its tile progresses the build one turn (consuming its action); completion is announced.
children.title: Workers advance construction

children.desc: A fortifying unit outside a city gains a fortify turn (reset to 0 inside cities).
children.title: Fortification deepens

children.desc: A unit holding formation outside a city gains a formation turn (reset to 0 inside cities).
children.title: Formation deepens

children.desc: Temporarily hidden units tick toward being revealed.
children.title: Hidden countdown

children.desc: A unit set to auto-harvest collects the resource it is standing on if it can.
children.title: Auto-harvest fires

children.desc: Generals and explorers grant their rating XP; player effects add per-turn (and idle) XP.
children.title: XP from leaders and effects

children.desc: Generals and explorers grant their rating XP; player effects add per-turn (and idle) XP.
children.title: XP from leaders and effects

children.desc: Effect-based heal/damage plus idle healing (if the unit did nothing and can heal here); then terrain and height attrition.
children.title: Healing and attrition apply

children.desc: A unit on auto-heal spends its turn healing while still damaged (cleared once it cannot).
children.title: Auto-heal action

children.desc: Effect-based heal/damage plus idle healing (if the unit did nothing and can heal here); then terrain and height attrition.
children.title: Healing and attrition apply

children.desc: Generals and explorers grant their rating XP; player effects add per-turn (and idle) XP.
children.title: XP from leaders and effects

children.desc: A caravan with a mission target moves toward that capital and completes its mission on arrival. (May remove the unit.)
children.title: Caravans advance

children.desc: Raiders whose target team has been eliminated stop raiding and convert to barbarians.
children.title: Raids on dead teams end

steps.desc: Each of your units takes its upkeep turn (wake checks, timers, work, healing, XP) — the per-unit sequence below.
steps.title: Units process

steps.cond: Doomed and the death roll hits

steps.title: Doomed characters may die

steps.desc: Traits queued by events with a delayed probability roll now.
steps.title: Delayed trait probabilities resolve

steps.desc: Random traits queued with a delay are assigned now.
steps.title: Delayed random traits resolve

steps.desc: Pending random character relationships (rivalries, friendships) are assigned now.
steps.title: Delayed relationships resolve

children.desc: If a death trait fires, a leader gains Doomed instead of dying instantly (a one-year warning); anyone else dies now.
children.title: Death roll → Doomed for leaders

children.desc: A non-leader (or already-Doomed) character whose death trait fired dies here.

children.desc: A small chance the character picks up a nickname.

children.desc: Event classes with a per-character probability may fire, then the new-turn character event trigger runs.
children.title: Character event rolls

children.desc: When events are off (AI autoplay), young successors gain random rating points instead of tutored growth.

steps.desc: Families short on adults or children (relative to the cities they hold) spawn new characters.
steps.title: Families replenish

steps.cond: skipped on the player's very first turn
steps.desc: If the royal roster exceeds roughly year/25 + 5, the character furthest down the succession retires; the leader, heirs and family heads are always un-retired.
steps.title: Old royals retire

steps.cond: skipped on the player's very first turn
steps.desc: Each family re-evaluates who leads it.
steps.title: Family heads update

steps.cond: skipped on the player's very first turn
steps.desc: From turn 10, each family (staggered, every 4 turns) adopts whichever religion is most common among its members.
steps.title: Families may adopt religions

steps.cond: skipped on the player's very first turn
steps.desc: Each tribe evaluates its per-player diplomacy (offers, demands, attitude shifts).
steps.title: Tribes run diplomacy at you

steps.cond: skipped on the player's very first turn
steps.desc: AI players (only) evaluate diplomacy toward every other player — humans are considered first.
steps.title: AI player diplomacy

steps.desc: Missions whose duration has elapsed resolve — deliberately after character turns, so mid-event state changes (e.g. a suitor marrying) invalidate cleanly.

steps.desc: All active Occurrences apply their per-player effects and tile changes to you.
steps.title: Occurrence effects apply

steps.desc: Event-chain links past their turn limit (or marked immediate) are removed.
steps.title: Event links expire

steps.desc: All ambition and quest progress is recomputed against the new game state.
steps.title: Goals re-evaluate

steps.desc: Unfinished quests with zero turns left are removed.
steps.title: Quests time out

steps.desc: Unfinished ambitions with zero turns left are removed (failed).
steps.title: Ambitions time out

steps.desc: Pending decisions that are no longer valid are removed.
steps.title: Stale decisions pruned

steps.desc: Old map pins and reminders are cleared or re-announced.
steps.title: Map pings expire

steps.desc: If you have a free ambition slot and nothing pending, threshold-goal offers fire first, then a standard ambition offer can roll.
steps.title: New ambition may be offered

steps.desc: Cities set to auto-manage choose what to produce.
steps.title: Automated cities pick builds

steps.desc: Units with queued move-to / build-road orders carry them out (cancelled if the path is gone).
steps.title: Queued unit orders execute

steps.desc: Cumulative yield totals are logged for the graphs.
steps.title: Graphs record totals

steps.desc: Victory conditions, defeats and game-over states are evaluated.
